name: Branch: User Asks for Leave, Then Cancels
goal: User initiates a leave request but cancels before confirmation.
constraints: Bot should handle cancellation gracefully and not submit leave.

phases.description: User says 'Mujhe 20 se 22 July tak casual leave chahiye'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for confirmation or reason for leave.

phases.description: User says 'Cancel kar do, abhi nahi chahiye'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms leave request is cancelled and nothing is submitted.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
